tools.name: get_automations
tools.description: Read the outgoing event to automation names setting.

tools.name: configure_automations
tools.description: Replace the outgoing event to automation names setting. Configure each named automation in the kernel first. An empty list explicitly disables forwarding for that event.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The GitHub accounts this App uses: label, login, status and API rate limit. Accounts are bound by the owner in the kernel; this lists the ones the App knows.

tools.name: add_account
tools.description: Make the App use a GitHub account the owner bound in the kernel (label as bound). The App checks it by reading its user.

tools.name: remove_account
tools.description: Stop using an account in this App. The owner's binding in the kernel is not changed.

tools.name: set_default_account
tools.description: Use this account when a call names none.

tools.name: set_repo_account
tools.description: Use this account for one repository, or the default again when account is absent.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: API rate limits of the accounts (core and search) and which accounts work.

account.description: The account to use; the default account when absent.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: Repositories the account can see, most recently pushed first.

account.description: The account to use; the default account when absent.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
